item.text:
Refactored the get path in `reindex-management` so the transport action no longer owns the probe/fetch validation flow. That logic now lives in [ReindexTaskLookup.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/modules/reindex-management/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/reindex/management/ReindexTaskLookup.java:24), which encapsulates probe request construction, fetch request construction, probe validation, and reindex-specific not-found wrapping. [TransportGetReindexAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/modules/reindex-management/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/reindex/management/TransportGetReindexAction.java:25) is now just the transport entry point delegating to that helper.

I added direct helper coverage in [ReindexTaskLookupTests.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/modules/reindex-management/src/test/java/org/elasticsearch/reindex/management/ReindexTaskLookupTests.java:21) and updated [TransportGetReindexActionTests.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/modules/reindex-management/src/test/java/org/elasticsearch/reindex/management/TransportGetReindexActionTests.java:33) to use the helper’s not-found entry point. `git diff --check` passed.
